a fully electric eco friendly compact executive sedan that combines performance, minimalist design, and advanced technology. It features a sleek, aerodynamic body with a glass roof, a spacious interior dominated by a central touchscreen, and seating for five passengers. Known for its quick acceleration, the Model 3 offers multiple variants, including Standard Range Plus, Long Range, and Performance trims, with ranges of up to 570 km (354 miles) per charge. It includes advanced safety features, over-the-air software updates, and access to Tesla’s Autopilot system for semi-autonomous driving.

a luxury compact SUV that blends sporty performance with refined comfort and all-weather capability. Powered by a turbocharged 2.0-liter 4-cylinder engine paired with a mild hybrid system, it delivers around 258 horsepower and smooth acceleration through a 9-speed automatic transmission. The AMG styling package enhances its exterior with aggressive bumpers, larger wheels, and sportier details, while the 4MATIC all-wheel drive system provides confident handling and traction. Inside, it offers a premium cabin with high-quality materials, advanced infotainment, and driver assistance features, making it a versatile SUV for both city and highway driving

The 2022 Range Rover Velar combines luxury and performance with a bold, modern design. This mid-size SUV offers a range of powerful engines, including petrol, diesel, and a plug-in hybrid option, all paired with an 8-speed automatic transmission and all-wheel drive. With an impressive fuel economy and a spacious interior that accommodates up to five passengers, the Velar delivers comfort and versatility. Whether navigating city streets or off-road terrain, its advanced technology and refined style make it the perfect choice for those who demand both elegance and capability.

The 2023 Chevrolet Corvette Z51 is a high-performance sports car that blends iconic design with cutting-edge engineering. Powered by a 6.2L V8 engine, the Z51 Performance Package adds upgraded suspension, brakes, cooling, and an electronic limited-slip differential, making it ideal for track enthusiasts. With its aggressive styling, mid-engine layout, and rapid acceleration, the Corvette Z51 delivers a thrilling driving experience and exceptional handling on both road and track.

a luxury midsize SUV that seamlessly blends performance, comfort, and cutting-edge technology. Powered by a 3.0-liter turbocharged V6 engine producing 348 horsepower, it offers brisk acceleration and confident handling. The 8-speed automatic transmission and all-wheel-drive system ensure smooth and responsive driving dynamics. Inside, the Cayenne features a refined cabin with high-quality materials, advanced infotainment systems, and ample space for five passengers. With its versatile cargo capacity and a range of customizable options, the Cayenne Base caters to those seeking both practicality and the driving excitement synonymous with the Porsche brand.

blends iconic design with modern performance. Powered by a turbocharged 2.3L EcoBoost® engine delivering 315 horsepower and 350 lb-ft of torque, it offers exhilarating acceleration and responsive handling. The 10-speed SelectShift® automatic transmission ensures smooth gear transitions, while rear-wheel drive provides a classic sports car experience.

a plug-in hybrid sports car that combines a twin-turbocharged 3.0-liter V6 engine with an electric eco friendly motor, delivering a total output of 830 horsepower. This powertrain enables the 296 GTS to accelerate from 0 to 100 km/h in just 2.9 seconds and reach a top speed exceeding 330 km/

a compact car available in both sedan and hatchback body styles. It offers a choice of engines, including the naturally aspirated Skyactiv-G 2.5-liter engine producing 191 horsepower and 186 lb-ft of torque. The Mazda3 is known for its engaging driving dynamics, premium interior materials, and advanced safety features. It comes equipped with a user-friendly infotainment system and offers options like all-wheel drive and a turbocharged engine for enhanced performance.
a modern and versatile compact hatchback that blends advanced technology, efficiency, and stylish design. It offers a range of powertrains to suit various driving preferences
a mid-size fastback sedan that combines luxury, performance, and advanced technology. It features a sleek design with aerodynamic lines and a bold front grille, reminiscent of premium European sedans

The 2012 Hyundai Avante is equipped with a 1.6-liter GDi (Gasoline Direct Injection) inline-4 engine, producing around 138 horsepower. It offers a choice between a 6-speed manual or 6-speed automatic transmission, delivering power to the front wheels.This model is known for its sleek design, spacious interior, and fuel efficiency. With a wheelbase of 2,700 mm, it provides ample legroom for passengers. The Avante's suspension setup ensures a comfortable ride, making it suitable for both city commuting and longer journeys

a compact SUV that combines stylish design, advanced technology, and efficient performance. It features Peugeot's signature i-Cockpit® interior, offering a 12.3-inch digital instrument panel and an 8-inch touchscreen infotainment system. The exterior boasts a bold front grille, sleek LED headlights, and a dynamic silhouette
The 2012 Hyundai Elantra MD is a stylish and fuel-efficient compact sedan, known for its sleek design, comfortable interior, and reliable 1.6L gasoline engine

The Toyota RAV4 XLE is a popular compact SUV that balances utility, comfort, and fuel efficiency. The XLE trim typically includes features like alloy wheels, a power moonroof, dual-zone climate control, and Toyota's suite of safety tech (Toyota Safety Sense). It’s available with both front-wheel drive and all-wheel drive options and can be equipped with a traditional gasoline engine or a hybrid powertrain.

The 2021 Jeep Wrangler Unlimited Sahara is a four-door variant of Jeep's iconic off-road SUV, blending rugged capability with refined features. The Sahara trim offers body-colored fender flares, 18-inch alloy wheels, a premium infotainment system, and advanced safety technologies. It's available with multiple powertrain options, including a 3.6L V6, a 2.0L turbocharged inline-4, and a plug-in hybrid (4xe) variant.

The 2023 Mercedes-Benz S 580 4MATIC is a flagship luxury sedan that combines opulent comfort with advanced technology and robust performance. It features a 4.0-liter V8 biturbo engine paired with a mild hybrid system (EQ Boost), delivering a total output of 496 horsepower. The 4MATIC all-wheel-drive system ensures optimal traction and stability across various driving conditions.

The 2016 Mercedes-Benz S-Class 4MATIC is a luxury sedan that combines advanced technology, comfort, and performance. Available in both petrol and diesel variants, it features the 4MATIC all-wheel-drive system, ensuring optimal traction and stability.

The 2022 Mercedes-Benz C 300 is a luxury compact sedan that combines performance, comfort, and advanced technology. It features a 2.0-liter turbocharged inline-4 engine paired with a 48-volt mild-hybrid system, delivering 255 horsepower and 295 lb-ft of torque. The 4MATIC all-wheel-drive system ensures optimal traction and stability across various driving conditions.

The 2018 Mercedes-Benz C 300 4MATIC is a luxury compact sedan that combines performance, comfort, and advanced technology. It features a 2.0-liter turbocharged inline-4 engine paired with a 9-speed automatic transmission, delivering 241 horsepower. The 4MATIC all-wheel-drive system ensures optimal traction and stability across various driving conditions.

The 2025 Audi Q5 45 TFSI S line Premium Plus is a luxury compact SUV that combines performance, comfort, and advanced technology. It features a 2.0-liter turbocharged inline-4 engine paired with a 7-speed S tronic® dual-clutch automatic transmission, delivering 261 horsepower and 273 lb-ft of torque. The quattro® all-wheel-drive system ensures optimal traction and stability across various driving conditions. The S line Premium Plus trim adds sporty design elements and premium features, including a panoramic sunroof, Audi virtual cockpit, and advanced driver assistance systems

The xDrive all-wheel-drive system ensures optimal traction and stability across various driving conditions. The Premium Plus trim adds features like a panoramic sunroof, navigation system, and advanced driver assistance systems.

The 2014 Mercedes-Benz E 350 is a mid-size luxury vehicle available in various body styles, including sedan, coupe, and estate (wagon). It is equipped with a 3.5-liter V6 engine producing 302 horsepower and 273 lb-ft of torque, paired with a 7-speed automatic transmission. The E 350 offers both rear-wheel drive and 4MATIC all-wheel-drive options. Notable features include a refined interior, advanced safety systems, and a comfortable ride quality

The 2015 BMW M4 is a high-performance sports coupe that succeeded the M3 Coupe, introducing a new era of performance and efficiency. It is powered by a 3.0-liter twin-turbocharged inline-six engine producing 425 horsepower and 406 lb-ft of torque. This engine is paired with either a 6-speed manual or a 7-speed dual-clutch automatic transmission. The M4 features rear-wheel drive, adaptive suspension, and a lightweight construction utilizing carbon fiber-reinforced plastic components.

The 2016 BMW M4 Base is a high-performance sports coupe powered by a 3.0L twin-turbo inline-6 engine delivering 425 hp. It offers sharp handling, rear-wheel drive, and a choice between a 6-speed manual or 7-speed dual-clutch automatic transmission. Designed with lightweight materials and sporty tuning, it blends everyday usability with track-capable performance.
